scripts.test:core: cmake -S . -B out/build && cmake --build out/build --config Release && ctest --test-dir out/build -C Release --output-on-failure
scripts.wasm: emcmake cmake -S . -B out/wasm -DCPULAB_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DCPULAB_BUILD_WASM=ON && cmake --build out/wasm --config Release && node scripts/publish-wasm.mjs
scripts.qa:prod: npm run build && node scripts/qa-server.mjs start
scripts.qa:servers: npm run qa:dev && npm run qa:prod
scripts.qa:all: npm run verify:wasm && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run qa:servers && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run test:core && npm test && npm run test:e2e
